User Story: As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to create a patient record with a unique Patient ID, so that I can register new patients accurately.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to search for a patient by ID, name, or contact info, so that I can quickly find existing records.
As a Doctor, I want to view a patient's full journey in one screen, so that I can make informed care decisions.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to create an appointment with patient, doctor, department, date/time, and type, so that visits are scheduled correctly.
As a system, I want to support appointment statuses, so that appointment progress is trackable.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to update appointment details before the visit occurs, so that changes are reflected accurately.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to record whether a patient confirmed their appointment, so that attendance can be anticipated.
As a system, I want to generate and track appointment reminders, so that no-show risk is reduced.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to cancel an appointment and record a standardized reason, so that cancellation patterns can be analyzed.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to mark an appointment as a no-show and capture the reason, so that no-show patterns can be tracked.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to reschedule an appointment while preserving a link to the original, so that history isn't lost.
As a Doctor, I want to record that a consultation occurred and its outcome, so that next steps are documented.
As a Doctor, I want to recommend a procedure and record the patient's decision, so that procedure uptake can be measured.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to schedule an accepted procedure and track its status, so that completion can be monitored.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to capture the reason a procedure wasn't completed, so that drop-off causes are visible.
As a Doctor, I want to indicate whether follow-up is required, so that continuity of care is planned.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to create and track a follow-up appointment linked to the originating care event, so that follow-up compliance is measurable.
As a Front Desk Staff member, I want to capture the reason a patient missed a follow-up, so that patterns can be identified.
As a Patient Experience Team member, I want to record patient feedback, so that experience quality is measurable.
As a BI/Analytics User, I want feedback linked to the relevant appointment, procedure, or follow-up, so that experience data connects to outcomes.
As Hospital Management, I want the system to identify appointment drop-offs, so that at-risk patients are flagged.
As Hospital Management, I want to identify procedure and follow-up drop-offs, so that gaps in care completion are visible.
As a BI/Analytics User, I want to identify patients with repeated drop-off events, so that intervention can be targeted.
As Hospital Management, I want to see attendance, no-show, and cancellation rates, so that operational performance is visible.
As Hospital Management, I want procedure completion and follow-up compliance rates, so that care continuity is measurable.
As Hospital Management, I want an overall patient retention rate, so that retention trends are trackable.
As a Department Head, I want doctor- and department-level performance metrics, so that I can review team performance fairly.
As Hospital Management, I want a management dashboard with key KPIs, filterable by date/department/doctor/status, so that I can monitor performance at a glance.
As Hospital Management, I want a drop-off dashboard showing where patients disengage across the journey, so that improvement efforts are targeted.
